title: Zotero Paper Read-to-Cite Rate
dataSources: Highlights (`reading:highlight`), book activity (`reading:book`), reviews (`reading:review`), paper libraries (`research:paper`), sync states (`reading:sync`).
app: Reading and second-brain telemetry — Readwise review exports, Kindle highlights, Goodreads shelves, and Zotero research libraries — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=research:paper collection=* cited_in_notes=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(cited_in_notes="yes",1,0))) as matched by collection
| eval a_citation_in_notes_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_citation_in_notes_pct
description: Measures the percentage of Zotero papers that end with a citation in notes by collection.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which collection are helping or hurting Zotero papers.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a citation in notes` on `research:paper` events and summarize the hit rate by `collection`.
visualization: Table of collection with percentage of Zotero papers ending with a citation in notes.
grandmaExplanation: It flags how often a citation in notes happens for each collection so you can see where Zotero papers go smoothly or get stuck.
